summary: ARC Group Acquisition I Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its IPO on May 1, 2026. The company sold 12,075,000 units (including full over-allotment of 1,575,000 units) at $10.00 per unit, generating gross proceeds of $120.75 million. Each unit consists of one ordinary share, one right (receiving 1/4 ordinary share upon business combination), and one warrant (exercisable at $11.50 per share). The funds are held in trust for a future business combination. This is a standard SPAC IPO filing; no target or deal terms are disclosed. Watch for the company's search for a merger target within the typical 18-24 month timeframe.
